newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper up on poor supply, global price rise.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper up on poor supply, global price rise.

text.p: Indian copper prices firmed up on Monday on poor supply and rising global prices while other base metals traded steady in a narrow price band, traders said.

Copper rose by 50 rupees to 12,800 rupees per quintal, dealers said. They said trade was limited but sentiments were firm on expectations that a state-owned firm would hike its selling prices for next month.
Nickel was steady at 36,500 rupees per quintal.
Other metals were little changed with aluminium at 7,250 rupees, zinc at 6,750 rupees and lead at 4,550 rupees per quintal, dealers said. Tin was unchanged at 34,400 rupees.
